article.title: China’s Moonshot to Release Breakthrough AI Model for Download
article.summary: Moonshot AI is poised to make its Kimi K3 model available for public download, expanding its reach and influence in the global open software community at a time of growing US concern about Chinese encroachment into the top echelons of AI development.
article.title_zh: 中國 Moonshot 將發佈突破性 AI 模型供下載
article.summary_zh: Moonshot AI 準備推出其 Kimi K3 模型供公眾下載，在美國日益關注中國在 AI 開發頂端的擴展之際，擴大其在全球開源軟體社區中的影響力。

article.title: China Vows Response to US Sanctions Threat Against AI Firms
article.summary: China warned it would take “all necessary measures” if the US moves to sanction Chinese artificial intelligence companies over allegations they improperly used American models to train their own systems.
article.title_zh: 中國誓言如美國對AI公司實施制裁將做出回應
article.summary_zh: 中國警告稱，如果美國對涉嫌不當使用美國模型訓練其系統的中國AI公司實施制裁，將採取「一切必要措施」。

article.title_zh: Verizon 與 Google 達成 10 億美元 DCI 交易；AI 雲端與邊緣銷售將在 2027 年升溫
article.summary_zh: Verizon 表示其傳統電信業務轉型加速，但更大機會在於 AI 基礎設施，包括連接資料中心、城域中心和邊緣場所，首先從 Google 合作開始。

article.title: Building the enterprise environment for agentic AI
article.summary: For the enterprise, the promise of agentic AI is much more than just a better chatbot. It is software agents that execute business tasks end-to-end across people, business workflows, data, and systems. The platform best-suited to run agents is built with proper CPU capacity, resilient data access, policy-aware tool use, observability, memory management, and the ability to predictably plan and scale agents. To better understand some of these dependencies, Intel performed thousands of agentic AI workload experiments. Our initial findings create and support five practical lessons for enterprise leaders: Agentic AI is a larger systems problem, not just one of inference. The majority of existing agentic AI harnesses are limited and do not measure overall system performance. Plan capacity is don
article.summary_zh: 對於企業而言，agentic AI的承諾遠不止於更好的聊天機器人，而是能夠跨越人員、業務工作流程、數據和系統端到端執行業務任務的軟體代理。

article.title: Dynatrace’s new agents can reveal the single hardest part of AI operations
article.summary: Observability platform company Dynatrace announced a set of advancements to its Dynatrace Intelligence service on Monday that aim to take the autonomous SRE (site reliability engineer) out of its probabilistic approach of the past. The goal is to move forward to now work with more deterministic real-time context and control.  New extensions are designed to automatically resolve software infrastructure operations incidents and prevent service disruptions, while still maintaining human oversight and governance. Dynatrace Intelligence was initially launched at Perform , the company’s flagship user conference, in January of this year. Dynatrace is now adding new autonomous agents for incident triage and remediation, as well as no-code custom agent creation capabilities. The platform
article.title_zh: Dynatrace 的新 Agent 可以揭示 AI 運營中最困難的部分
article.summary_zh: 可觀測性平台公司 Dynatrace 在週一宣布了 Dynatrace Intelligence 服務的一系列進展，旨在將自主 SRE（網站可靠性工程師）從過去的概率方法轉變為更具確定性的實時運作。

article.title: Samsung’s flagship lineup may grow to 8 phones a year with the Galaxy Z TriFold 2
article.summary: TL;DR A new report claims that Samsung’s second-generation Galaxy Z TriFold could launch alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 9 series next year. The company is also expected to introduce a Galaxy S27 Pro, creating a “4+4” flagship strategy with four Galaxy S phones and four foldables every year. Unlike the first Galaxy Z TriFold, which had a limited production run, Samsung could manufacture the second-generation model in larger numbers. Just days after Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Z Fold 8 , Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra , and Galaxy Z Flip 8 , reports are already emerging about what could be the company’s most ambitious flagship smartphone plans yet. article.title_zh: Samsung 旗艦陣容可能擴展至每年 8 款手機，Galaxy Z TriFold 2 將加入
article.summary_zh: 報導稱 Samsung 的第二代 Galaxy Z TriFold 可能與 Galaxy Z Fold 9 系列同期推出，並推出 Galaxy S27 Pro，實現每年推出四款 Galaxy S 手機和四款摺疊機的「4+4」策略。

article.title: SoftBank’s $40 Billion Loan for OpenAI Stake Gets 21 New Lenders
article.summary: SoftBank Group Corp.’s $40 billion bridge loan for its investment in US tech giant OpenAI has attracted a new group of 21 lenders in a broader syndication phase, according to people familiar with the matter.
article.title_zh: SoftBank 的 400 億美元 OpenAI 股份貸款吸引 21 家新貸款機構
article.summary_zh: SoftBank Group Corp. 為投資美國科技巨頭 OpenAI 而籌集的 400 億美元橋接貸款已在更廣泛的銀團組織階段吸引了 21 家新貸款機構。

article.title: Nvidia in Talks to Back OpenAI Lease of $500 Billion Data Center
article.summary: Nvidia Corp. is in discussions to provide a financing guarantee to help OpenAI lease computing from a US data center project planned for 2028, underscoring how the world’s most valuable company is funneling capital into the infrastructure that drives its business.
article.title_zh: Nvidia 洽談支持 OpenAI 租賃 5,000 億美元數據中心
article.summary_zh: Nvidia Corp. 正在討論提供融資擔保，以幫助 OpenAI 從一個計畫於 2028 年啟動的美國數據中心項目租賃運算資源，凸顯全球最具價值公司如何將資本注入推動其業務發展的基礎設施。

article.title: Preparing For AI-Driven Chip Design And Verification
article.summary: Key Takeaways: Agentic AI will fundamentally change how engineers approach design and verification, and it will require them to adapt or be left behind. AI is a black box, so ensuring reliability will require external observability through sandboxing, along with other safeguards in case something does go wrong. The concentration of profitability in a few companies will shift as agents become more customized for different markets and workloads and as more fab capacity opens the door for new and existing players. article.title_zh: 為AI驅動的晶片設計與驗證做準備
article.summary_zh: 代理式AI將從根本上改變工程師的設計和驗證方法，需要採用沙箱隔離等保障措施來確保可靠性。
